notes.title: Global graphics redesign
notes.notes:
We’ve decided to completely update graphics in Deep, In the Forest:
To increase the visual quality and character development so that each character has their own temper and peculiarities;
To make the environment more detailed and atmospheric.
Up to the moment, we’ve redesigned all the characters. It only remains to redraw the environment.
Also, we’re planning to add some visual effects, to arrange the sound and fix the balance in the game.

notes.title: Update #21
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest![/h2]
This update brings minor improvements and fixes.
The merchant’s store will become more useful and attractive to players. This should give more value to cards giving gold.
The hero will level up more often during the game. This will give players more opportunities to change their starting deck.
Changes in the growth of the opponents difficulty. Now the difficulty of the battles should create a better experience for the players, but at the same time remain interesting enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137320/6b96b832b7069bc1b38c143ed64489673d0fc4d1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Changes in version 1.05:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Performance improvement
[*] The number of cards in the merchant's store has been increased to 6.
[*] Now in the merchant's store you can refresh his stocks 1 time.
[*] The experience curve has changed. Now at the beginning of the game the level increase will occur a little less often. But the difference between the required amount of experience for the next level is significantly reduced. Thus, the level increase during the game will occur more often. For comparison, now the player will be able to reach level 20 when starting a new campaign 3 times faster.
[*] Increasing the level gives less bonus health points and restores 5% less health.
[*] Corrections in the growth curve of the foes difficulty. Due to a bug, foes used to get too strong too fast. This created a negative experience for the players.
[/olist]
[h3]What's next?[/h3]
[olist]
[*] In the next update I want to completely review the combos and synergies of cards. It will be a big update.
[*] We also plan to make a number of visual improvements to cards and indicators of the abilities of foes.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update #19

[h3]Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest![/h3]
We're finally releasing the game! Almost a year we worked hard making this game. It was a very difficult year.
But leaving early access does not mean that we will stop working to improve the game. There is always a room for improvement =) We still have a lot of cool ideas, but now it’s very important for us to understand if the game is interesting to the players.
[h2]Thanks to everyone who has been with us all this time! 
We hope you liked our game.[/h2]

[olist]

[*] Minor corrections in the animations of the Mad King and the beaver.

[*] The bug of calculating the damage of the “Payback" card has been fixed. It did 1 damage less than should.

notes.title: Weekly Update #16
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
This update focuses on the bugfix and balance of the game.
The balance of progression of complexity has undergone very strong changes. It is highly recommended that you start a new campaign.
After the last update, I had to release a number of hotfixes. Their description will be included in this update.

[h3]Changes in version 0.701.[/h3]

[h3]Bugfix:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug of the effect of stunning or causing damage by combo ability to an already defeated enemy.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the player sometimes could get 2 times more cards at the beginning of the turn.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the player’s turn automatically ended ahead of time when drawing new cards with an empty hand.
[*] Fixed a bug leading to the crash of the game when playing several cards in a row very fast.
[*] Fixed a bug of items affecting the maximum value of health points. Previously, they were allowed to restore health or completely lose it to 0.
[*] Items that affect the maximum health no longer interact with the current health value.
[*] Fixed map scrolling bug on region screen.
[*] The description of the reaction trait until the enemy takes damage several times in a row is corrected.
[*] Fixed a bug of the wrong threat level at the start of the first region, sometimes leading to foes having zero attack value.
[*] Fixed a bug of the missing avatar of the baron of the west in the dialogue after defeating him.
[*] Fixed a bug of the trait of foes to cause damage, depending on the remaining health of the foe. Previously, it caused damage depending on lost health, which led to unpleasant situations for players. Like sudden defeat.
[*] Fixed layout for one of the routes in the western region.
[*] Fixed a bug leading to blurry phrases of foes in battles.
[/olist]
[h3]Character development:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Reduced penalty for rerolling a pool of cards for replacement on lvlup. Penalty reduced from 2 to 1. This increases the overall selection of cards from 6 to 10.
[*] The amount of experience required to increase the level is increased. But the difference between the required amount of experience between levels is significantly reduced. In general, the level increase should occur less often at the beginning of the game, but more often in the middle and end game compared to the previous settings.
[*] Removed the level cap of the hero.
[*] Changed the number of bonus max HP for each level of the hero. Each new level gives a fixed value - 2 max. HP. In general, players will receive significantly less growth of max Hp from leveling up.
[/olist]
[h3]The battle:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The distribution of foes in battles has been changed. In difficult battles, there are always 3 opponents. There are always 2 opponents in normal battles.
[*] For casual game mode, the number of foes in battles will be 1 less than in normal mode.
[*] The health gain of opponents, depending on the level of threat, is reduced by 30%.
[*] Health and attack bonus for hard battles are 50% less than before.
[*] The probability of activating enemy traits depending on the threat level is increased by 100%
[*] All the barons and the King received +40 HP.
[/olist]
[h3]Cards:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The cost of drawing a "Nope" card is reduced by 1.
[*] Experience from the card “You never know best” increased from 5 to 10.
[*] The “Legacy” card has been greatly reworked. Received gold reduced from 500 to 100. When played, you no longer get rid of the card, but convert it to energy. Energy cost increased from 0 to 1.
[*] The cards  "Exhaustion" and "Wound" have changed their effects. Now the “Wound” card can be played to get rid of it. “Wound” card energy cost increased from 0 to 1.
[*] The number of initially unlocked cards is significantly increased.
[*] The starting hand of the hero also changed. Now it contains cards of all types and features a variety of new mechanics.
[/olist]
[h3]Interface:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Added information about the current energy income in the character section on the region’s screen.
[*] A tooltip of key words has been added for a new unlocked card in the dialog after winning a battle.
[*] Updated description of foes traits in the tutorial.
[/olist]

[h3]What to expect in the following weekly updates:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Global improvement of interfaces in the game.
[*] The end of the game.
[*] Continuing the balancing of the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update #15 (Major)
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
This update focuses on new content. Added 47 new cards, 48 ​​new items!
Many new mechanics and abilities, improvements and changes for the old. Almost all old items are reworked. Improved the art of cards and items! And much more.
The game has become bigger, deeper and more interesting!

[h3]Changes in version 0.655.[/h3]
[h3]Cards:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] 47 new cards.
[*] Many old cards have changed their name.
[*] Rebalance of some old cards.
[*] Improved art for 6 old cards.
[*] New mechanic: convert other cards from your hand into energy income.
[*] New mechanic: convert the played card into an energy income.
[*] Keyword for convert mechanic.
[*] Keyword for “dispose cards from the hand”.
[*] New mechanic: gaining additional experience as the ability of the card.
[*] Color to indicate the value of the experience gained by the ability of the card.
[*] Damage immunity mechanic replaced by blocking the first incoming damage. This applies to foes and the player.
[*] Fixed a bug of validation payment of paying a card by reducing the energy gain.
[*] Keyword for health loss. Health loss has been replaced with taking damage.
[/olist]
[h3]Items:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] 48 new items.
[*] Improved visual representation of all items.
[*] New property: heal upon activation.
[*] New property: Ignore the next incoming damage upon activation.
[*] New property: mass interruption of foe’s abilities upon activation.
[*] New property: gain energy upon activation.
[*] New property: gain armor upon activation.
[*] New property: loss of armor to activate the item.
[*] New property: taking damage to activate the item.
[*] New property: complete disregard for recreation areas.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing you to activate items not on your turn.
[*] Improved description for activating items.
[*] Minor changes to improve readability of properties.
[*] A heroic item that increases energy gain with each card conversion no longer has this property. This property has been completely removed from the game.
[/olist]
[h3]Misc:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Added a one-time warning if the player tries to end the turn without converting the card into energy. This is necessary for teaching new players this game mechanic.
[/olist]

[h3]What to expect in the following weekly updates:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Global improvement of interfaces in the game.
[*] The end of the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update # 14
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
This update focuses on improving cards. Added keywords and tooltips for effects. Significantly reduced text on cards. Many old cards have been reworked. Added 12 new cards. Treasure reward changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137320/021db43f77e425929b1948315e17a5dbda29d176.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137320/3e0f6afcf7921ade9bba3d6330da3d4bd0497206.png[/img]

Changes in version 0.583.

Opponents:
[olist]
[*] Corrections for the icons of some foes abilities.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the help of the Baron of the East did not work correctly in the battle with the Mad King.
[*] Fixed a bug when the foe’s ability was activated after they defeat at the end of the battle. This broke the game and prevented the players from continuing the run.
[/olist]
Cards:
[olist]
[*] A keyword system for cards mechanics has been introduced. Significantly reduced text on cards.
[*] 18 keywords added for different mechanics.
[*] Added tooltips for keyword effects.
[*] Changes in the layout for the description section of cards. Now it is centered. For some cards, special rules are used to improve reading (forced new lines).
[*] A new mechanic: ignoring the next incoming damage. This mechanic has replaced invulnerability.
[*] A new mechanic: cure wound.
[*] A new mechanic: payment for activation effect by loss of armor.
[*] A new mechanic: payment for activation effect by loss of energy income.
[*] Big rework of old cards. Many cards received additional combo variants and were reduced in energy cost. Combo effects are directly or indirectly related to the type of card that activates them. Each type of card has a set of mechanics that is almost inaccessible to other types of cards, with the exception of combo effects.
[*] Added 12 new cards. These are mainly Defense and Healing cards.
[*] Fixed restriction for specific mechanics not working on the Barons and the Mad King. Previously, in a battle with the Baron or King, they could not be used on other foes too.
[/olist]
Map of the region:
[olist]
[*] Changes in treasure settings. Now they give rare items, but the chance to be ambushed is increased.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] New cards. Art is ready, it's up to me now to add them to the game.
[*] New items.
[*] Improving the appearance of items.
[*] Global improvement of interfaces in the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update #13
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
In this update, we focused on improvements related to foes and cards. Reworking traits of foes should give more personality to regions and foes. Players can now play more cards per turn without fear of being on the next turn without cards. Improved readability of cards.

Changes in version 0.532.

Cards:
[olist]
[*] Minimum draw of cards increased from 2 to 4. This change will allow players to play more cards during the turn.
[*] Updated the cards draw tutorial.
[*] Added color indication for numbers on cards. Each type of number has its own color. This should facilitate readability of cards.
[*] Improved the presentation of cards and tooltips. This has led to increased readability of text on cards and tooltips. Text now is more crisp.
[*] Fixed cases when the text of the cards went beyond the edges of the text area.
[/olist]
Foes:
[olist]
[*] Reworked traits of foes. Again. Now traits are determined by regions. In the western region, the enemy uses traits with time delay. In the northern region, traits are activated when dealing damage, but have a chance of failure. In the eastern region, all traits are built on the principle of reactions to player actions. In the central region, a mix of different types of traits.
[*] Almost all the names of the traits were renamed to improve the player's associative memorization.
[*] Traits have been redesigned to support the modular structure. Now they have the effect and type of activation indicated. The effect can be used in different regions, while the type of activation is strictly linked to the region.
[*] Updated icons for traits. Icons indicate the effect. If the effect has different types of activation within the same region, then the icons of such effect will differ, but indicated with the same color.
[*] Added new types of reactions. Reaction to the healing of a player and to the defeat of another foe.
[/olist]
Campaign:
[olist]
[*] Difficulty levels renamed.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Keywords for cards. Already in the work. This will reduce the amount of text and make it easier to remember cards and effects.
[*] New cards. Art is ready, it's up to me now to add them to the game.
[*] New items.
[*] Improving the visual style of items.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update #12
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
We are happy to finally introduce you a new region. Now you can go to the eastern region. A new baron will be waiting for you there, very different from others in both story and behavior.
We also decided to remove the southern region. Initially, we planned that the game would be ... simpler. But now there is a lot of everything in it and, as you may have noticed, adding a new region turned out to be a very time consuming task. In addition, it increases the amount of maintenance work with new new features added and changes to old.
Generally I don’t think adding another region will make the game better. Bigger, for sure. But instead, we would like to focus on improving the depth and quality of existing content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137320/59feb90cb34e880ff0d1461ec838402434b27eef.jpg[/img]

Changes in version 0.501.

Campaign:
[olist]
[*] New region. Noble samurais, cunning ninjas and many others are waiting for you there =)
[*] Changed the internal logic for generating and storing missions for regions. After the update, the progress of the current player’s mission will be lost. But the global progress of the campaign will remain.
[/olist]
Regions:
[olist]
[*] Special background for missions in the eastern region.
[*] 6 unique routes for the eastern region.
[/olist]
Foes:
[olist]
[*] 11 new foes. Each with its own story and personality.
[*] 64 new character lines for opponents from the eastern region.
[*] The new baron, ruling the eastern region - Asako-san. She has her own dialogue when a player wins. And special behavior if she comes to the aid of the player in the battle with the king.
[*] A special card for the execution of the baron of the east is the Baron’s shadow. A new mechanic was added - copying the effect of the last played card in battle. It is a unique mechanic added specially for this card.
[*] A new trait for the foes: shadow master. So far, only the baron of the east possesses it. The shadow master can summon shadow clones to confuse the player and avoid damage. Shadow clones disappear upon taking any damage.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not allow to interrupt the reaction traits.
[*] A new type of reaction for foes is a reaction to playing several cards in a row.
[*] Changed the logic for interrupting phrases of foes. The first press of any key completes the phrase completely. Pressing any key again closes it.
[*] The design of the baron of the western region has been updated. Now he looks more stylish.
[*] Traits for the foes are regrouped.
[*] Preparations have begun for a global change for the traits of foes. In the future, they will be built on the basis of “if-then” blocks. This will simplify the creation of new traits and increase variability.
[*] Updated baron icons in dialogs after a player wins.
[/olist]
Cards:
[olist]
[*] Updated art for existing cards for the barons and the king.
[*] Updated campaign map. Removed the southern region. Changed icons of bosses for regions.
[/olist]
Battle:
[olist]
[*] Updated scale for battle backgrounds in the northern region.
[*] Adaptation of the placement of foes in the battle with the king. There may be an unusually large number of foes.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Next week I plan to fundamentally redo the traits of foes. Again =) This should give each existing region more personality.
[*] New cards with new mechanics. Already in the work.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update # 11
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
This week we will not release a new update. The game is getting bigger and bigger. Adding a new region turned out to be a much more complex task than we expected. As a result, we did not manage to completely debug and implement all the changes associated with the addition of the eastern region, so the current build is extremely unstable and not ready for publication.
On the other hand, next week a big update is expected with a lot of new things =)

notes.title: Weekly Update #10
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
This update focuses on the consequences of victories over the barons and the behavior of the king. Now, the decision to execute or spare the baron has tangible consequences. You either get a unique baron card or he comes to your aid in the battle with the king. The king, in turn, has become much more dangerous. But if you managed to restore order in the regions then the battle with the king should become much easier.
Unfortunately, I have not had time to add a dialogue of victory over the king and plot endings in this update. But I think next week it should definitely be completed.

Changes in version 0.315.

The battle:
[olist]
[*] When the baron is executed, you get a special card in your deck that you can add to the main deck of the campaign if you wish. The baron’s card is unique - it cannot be obtained in any other way in the game. The baron’s card should be useful in normal battles and extremely useful in battle with the king.
[*] If you spared the baron, then he comes to the rescue in the battle with the king. Each baron helps in his own way, but does not participate directly in the battle.
[*] Added a window of phrases for barons and special phrases when they enter the battle with the king. Added phrases for  the king to reply to barons.
[*] The king learned to call his guards to help. The call for the guards occurs at some intervals. The call for the guards is NOT endless and can be prevented.
[*] The king learned to summon undefeated barons to his aid.
[*] In the battle with the king, the escalation of the battle is disabled.
[*] Added display of extracting cards from the player’s deck in battle. This is mostly for the situation when the cards in the deck are disposed, for example, negative effects.
[/olist]
Cards:
[olist]
[*] Added mechanics for disposing all temporary effect cards from the deck and discard.
[*] Added mechanics for getting wound cards during a play. This mechanic will be an alternative to energy, payment with a gold or loss of health as a mandatory part of a card effect activation.
[/olist]
Interface:
[olist]
[*] Fixed display of the game for different aspects of the screens.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Eastern region. Already in the work.
[*] Different options for the game ending. The dialogue with the king after the victory.
[*] New cards with new mechanics.
[*] New items with new features.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update #9
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
In this update, we again focused on the plot of the game. Now you can talk with the defeated barons and find out a little more about them... before deciding their fate.
We are also actively working on adding the last two regions to the game. Unlike the previous regions that we formed gradually, we want to release these ready at once. Because of this, the amount of changes in weekly updates for players may seem small.

Changes in version 0.301.

Campaign Map:
[olist]
[*] In each region, the icon of the corresponding boss is displayed.
[/olist]
Opponents:
[olist]
[*] Regulation of the duration of phrases of opponents in the game settings window.
[*] Reworked counting the duration of phrases of opponents.
[/olist]
The plot:
[olist]
[*] Many corrections in the texts.
[*] New music theme for intro. We replaced the old music theme with a more suitable one in terms of dynamics.
[*] The dialog window after victory over the barons. After winning, you can talk with the baron before making a decision. Decisions became more plotted, as did their consequences. Unfortunately, the mechanism of the consequences of these decisions has not yet been implemented. It will be in the next update. A similar mechanism will be added after the victory over the king. But only after all 4 barons appear in the game and their storylines are finally presented.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Eastern and southern regions. Already in the work.
[*] The consequences of the decisions made in the dialogue over the defeated barons.
[*] New cards with new mechanics.
[*] New items with new features.
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly update #8
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
This update adds to the game the long-awaited story entry at the start of a new campaign. A new type of traits for foes appeared - reaction. Reactions should make the battle more interactive. And we added 6 new routes for regions.
Also we posted our roadmap. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1188430/discussions/0/2872668702540648354/]Check it out.[/url]

[h3]Changes in version 0.281.[/h3]

The plot:
[olist]
[*] Added story intro at the start of the campaign. So far, temporary music has been used during the intro.
[/olist]
Foe:
[olist]
[*] Foes have a new type of trait: reaction. Reaction triggers under certain conditions during the player’s turn.
[*] Before activating the reaction, the foe will say something, indicating activation.
[*] Added trait: Fast Reflexes. If the foe was damaged several times per turn (the number of times depends on the level of the trait), then the foe immediately makes a response attack without waiting for they turn.
[*] Added trait: Alarmed. If the foe was damaged several times per turn (the number of times depends on the level of the trait), then the foe will completely ignore the next incoming damage.
[*] Added trait: Agile. Reduces incoming damage 2 times until foe is dealt damage several times per turn (the number of times depends on the level of the trait).
[*] Added trait: Spiky. Returns % of the first incoming damage during your turn (the number of depends on the trait level).
[*] Reorganization of icons for traits. Now the icons display the type of trait, and are not tied to any particular trait.
[*] The tooltip of a trait shows its level.
[/olist]
Items:
[olist]
[*] Cursed Skull now gives 4 curse cards instead of 1.
[/olist]
Region map
[olist]
[*] Added 3 new routes for the western region.
[*] Added 3 new routes for the northern region.
[/olist]
The fight:
[olist]
[*] Experience and damage popups are not shown if the value is 0.
[*] Fixed display of experience in the victory window.
[/olist]
Campaign:
[olist]
[*] Added a window offering to share your impressions from the game on the forum after defeating the baron.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Eastern region. Already in work.
[*] Plot. The victory over the barons will become more ... significant =)
[*] New cards with new mechanics.

notes.notes:

This update is fully focused on expanding content and adding new characters to the game. And as a result - the expansion of the story in the game.
In addition, the characters have new mechanics, and the player has new cards. However, it is unlikely that you will be delighted to find these cards in your deck =)

Changes in version 0.255.

Opponents:
[olist]
[*] Added 5 new characters for the North region.
[*] Added 3 new characters for the West region.
[*] Added 11 new characters for the Center region.
[*] Now almost all the characters are strictly attached to their regions and are united by different plot lines within these regions. However, there remain several characters wandering around the regions. This is due to their plot lines.
[*] Added 84 phrases for new characters. At the moment, 201 phrases are written in the game. Because the source of all troubles is in the royal castle, it is logical that some characters in the castle can shed light on many plot events in the game. Can you gather all the pieces of the puzzle?

notes.title: Weekly Update #6
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
We are returning from a holiday vacation. This update is quite small, but it affects one of the fundamental systems - experience. I thoroughly redid the experience system, as I promised earlier. The goal is very simple - to make gaining experience more meaningful, directly correlating with the actions of the player. If everything works out as intended, then the speed of character development (i.e., character skills) will directly depend on the speed of development of your skills as a player =)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137320/6704c36a72cc7a0bf029709cf4fd086db320461f.jpg[/img]

We added our first achievement - Early Bird. It will be available ONLY in early access and is intended for people who believed in us and supported the game while it was in early access. To get an achievement, just enter the game and join the battle.
Thus, you will officially become one of the first to oppose the Mad King =)

Changes in version 0.227.

The fight:
[olist]
[*] Experience is now awarded only for playing cards. On each card is written how much experience it will give. If a card is played with an active combo effect, the experience gained for it increases.
[*] When you gain experience, you will see a pop-up inscription above the portrait of the character indicating how much experience you just got.
[*] At the end of the battle, you can study detailed information on how much experience you received from which source.
[*] Fixed a bug when sometimes a card was flickering in the middle of the screen at the beginning of the battle. The bug was not regular and difficult to reproduce, so for a long time I could not understand what the problem was.
[*] Added notification of the battle escalation .
[*] A bug was fixed when the battle escalation began 2 rounds earlier than it should.
[*] Upon entering the battle, you will receive the Early Bird achievement. This achievement can only be obtained while the game is in early access.
[/olist]

Character development:
[olist]
[*] The amount of experience required to increase the level is greatly reduced.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Plot. The victory over the barons will become more ... significant =)
[*] A smoother introduction to the game setting and story at the beginning.
[*] New characters for the northern and central regions. Lots of new characters.
[*] New character abilities. Many new abilities. There is an idea to convey the personality of the enemy through their abilities. And also make ability sets specific only to specific regions.
[/olist]

notes.title: Unexpected update #1
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
We suddenly decided to release a sudden update right at the start of the week. We really wanted to please you with an important feature before going on vacation =)
I suddenly managed to make the difficulty levels in the game much faster than I expected. And Alexander suddenly drew new backgrounds for battles and variations of the hero depending on the difficulty level of the campaign. As a result, we decided that such a cool thing should not be postponed until January 10, because many of you will probably play on holidays =)

 Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Now we are definitely on vacations; D

notes.title: Weekly Update #3
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest!
This update focuses on changing the feeling from the game. Increasing the level of the hero has undergone major changes and now allows you to replace cards from the starting deck. Opponents have become more dangerous and require more attention.
And we also posted a new, more relevant trailer and new screenshots. And we got our own discord server. We will be glad to see you there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137320/8a2ece9dc070de18eff02af61ae69d37d1ff5d67.jpg[/img]

Changes in version 0.141.

Progress:
[olist]
[*] Level up no longer gives bonuses other than health. Reduced health regen value. Instead, the player is asked to select and replace 1 card from the starting deck with 1 of 4 random cards. The changes are applied to the current player deck and will be saved even in the event of a defeat in the region. If you did not like the options, you can reroll 1 time. Then the choice is given for 2 cards less. Cards from the first selection do not participate in the second selection. Repeats are excluded. A selection always consists of different types of cards. The player is free not to change anything in his deck if does not want to.
[*] The selection of cards after the victory is changed. The award always involves cards of strictly different types.
[*] The chance of unlocking a common card is increased. The chance of unlocking a rare card is reduced. Rare must be rare, otherwise it is not rare =)
[*] Hard battles no longer have a chance to increase the reward to heroic level. Obtaining a heroic card in a random hard battle greatly broke the rest of the region progression and devalued the reward for defeating the Baron.
[*] Hard battles with some chance can lower the reward to normal level. Rare should be rare. And the common cards are actually not so bad when there are many options.
[*] The route of the next region is modified depending on the number of regions already completed. It gets a little harder.
[/olist]

Opponents:
[olist]
[*] For all opponents, increased health scale depending on the danger level.
[*] Almost all timer abilities are rebalanced. Timers have become much shorter, but the abilities themselves are not so strong. This should help to avoid the situation when the activation of one ability broke the player the whole battle, but at the same time forces the player to pay more attention to opponents' abilities. And just make them more memorable. Personally, I am now very afraid of a pack of foxes =)
[/olist]

Cards:
[olist]
[*] Buffed cards: Protection and Shield.
[*] Changed and expanded the list of cards unlocked for the player by default
[*] “Body slam”, “Shortcut”, “Winter stocks” have become rare. They are quite powerful cards and this is necessary to balance the distribution of cards by type and rarity.
[*] Description about the effect of the effect only in complex and ordinary battles is changed. It was meant that the ability cannot be applied to the Baron or the King. Now it is written that way.
[*] Fixed a bug where the effect of the activation combo was shown under the combo tag icon for the very left card in the hand.
[/olist]

Items:
[olist]
[*] The “Honey pot” is greatly buffed. Before that, it was completely useless.
[*] “Super Potion” has become rare. The power to restore health is reduced.
[*] “Strawberry Pie” completely changed its properties. Now it has become one-time activated and allows you to restore a small portion of health in battle. In fact, it is a less compact and weaker version of “Super Potion”.
[*] Items substrates are recolored in accordance with the color scheme of the rarity of the cards: blue, green, red.
[*] The name of the Bamboo sword is fixed. Not so bamboo.
[/olist]

Region map:
[olist]
[*] The route in the central region has changed a lot.
[*] Fixed a bug leading to a bold line in the tooltip
[/olist]

Misc:
[olist]
[*] Effects. Added damage effect for opponents and hero.
[*] Effects. Added stun effect for opponents
[*] Sounds. Changed the sound of converting cards into energy
[*] Fixed a bug breaking the game when leaving the battle to the main menu and returning to battle with the Continue button.
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Alexander is still working on new opponents for the northern and central regions, new combat locations. And there, new regions are just around the corner! =)
[*] Redesign of item behavior. There is an idea to make rare items add specific cards to the player’s deck when item is equipped and remove them accordingly. This will emphasize the uniqueness of rare items and give the player more control over the deckbuilding.
[*] Difficulty levels. Easy will allow you to go through the game...well, easy. Hard will remove the checkpoint system. Defeat in battle will mark the end of the campaign.
[*] Story. It’s time for the story to appear in the game.
[*] Bugfix and overall improvement in game quality. To make game more pleasant to play =)
[/olist]

notes.title: Weekly Update #2
notes.notes:
Greetings, the inhabitants of our little forest! Another week, another update.
The goal of this update was a global rebalance and redesign of cards. Great emphasis is placed on strengthening cards that give gold and cause damage. This required a change in the mechanics of gold in the game and the Merchant on the map of the region.
We also added new foes for the northern region. And did a first iteration on the balance of foes and their abilities.
Strongly recommended to start a new campaign =)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36137320/6579e590ba4e950d97b55f1bcb8ae2eedc185ad0.png[/img]
Changes in version 0.131.

Gameplay:
[olist]
[*] Progress. Gold is moved to the local progress of the region.
[*] Map of the region. Merchant behavior changed. Now you can always return to the Merchant as many times as you want. The merchant always sells 2 regular and 2 rare cards. Now any card from the game may appear at the Merchant’s shop, even if you have not unlocked it yet.
[*] Region map. Minor changes in 4 routes, due to changes in the Merchant.
[*] Region map. Major changes for the route of the central region.
[*] Cards. Completely removed Embrace / Find cards. Instead, we added 12 new cards.
[*] Cards. Added new mechanic for interrupting opponent's abilities. Interrupt only work in simple and hard battles. The abilities of the Barons and the King cannot be interrupted.
[*] Cards. Added new mechanic for activating the abilities of the card when it is discarded from the hand. The mechanic is presented in two variations.
[*] Cards. More than half of the cards have undergone changes in abilities, cost, or activation combos. Added more combo effects in the game, more synergy of different cards.
[*] Cards. The Stun ability no longer works on Barons and King.
[*] Cards. The logic for calculating the Hero Power bonus has changed. Now the bonus is added to the final damage of the card, after all calculations. It was originally designed that way, otherwise the cards dealing X damage per Y parameter became excessively strong.
[*] Cards. Payback card ability now takes into account cards in the deck, discard, and hand.
[*] Cards. The “Dispose” card ability has been reworked. Now the selected card is never returned to the player’s deck. At the same time, the “Dispose” card became single use.
[*] Cards. Some cards have been renamed.
[*] Cards. A new Heroic card “Legacy” has been added.
[*] Foes. Updated appearance of the Cat. State animations added.
[*] Foes. Added 6 new foes for the northern region.
[*] Foes. 5 foes in the western region will no longer appear in the northern region.
[/olist]

Interface:
[olist]
[*] Battle scene. General graphics improvements.
[*] Battle scene. Added an indicator about the possibility of converting the card into energy during the turn.
[*] Region map. Updated site points icons.
[*] Region map. Updated hero token. Now it is much easier to find with a short glance.
[*] Cards selection window. Replaced the “Continue” button with the “Skip” button. Many players did not understand that if you click this button, no map will be selected.
[*] Map selection window. A clarification has been added for what purpose map selection occurs.
[*] Cards selection window. Added the ability to hide the selection zone in order to check out the opponents and cards in hand.
[*] Merchant. Battle end window. Labels for cards rarity are added.
[*] Main menu. A notification has been added with a recommendation to start a new campaign in case of a large update.
[/olist]

Bug fixes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug allowing to escape from a battle with the Baron using a ninja scroll.
[*] Fixed a bug where the card should do 0 damage, but it still receive Power bonuses. The Power bonus should only be added if the card is capable of causing damage.
[*] Fixed bug of stuck tooltip of foe ability.
[*] Fixed a crash bug when clicking on the tutorial button in the settings at the first start of the game.
[*] Fixed image size of some cards.
[*] Fixed minor typos in text
[/olist]

What to expect in the following weekly updates:
[list]
[*] New trailer for the game. The game has changed a lot over the past few weeks. We did a lot of work, but this is not visible to potential new players =)
[*] I’m going to work on finalizing the opponents. Review their stats and behavior. The goal is to achieve better interactivity and personality. Especially for the Barons and the King.
[*] Alexander is working on new opponents for the northern and central regions, new combat locations
[*] Redesign of item behavior. There is an idea to make rare items add specific cards to the player’s deck when item is equipped and remove them accordingly. This will emphasize the uniqueness of rare items and give the player more control over the deckbuilding.
[*] Difficulty levels.
[*] Improving the leveling system. There is an idea to give the player at certain levels opportunity to replace 1 card from the starting deck slots with 1 of 3-4 cards from a fixed and fairly large pool of cards. This will allow the player to experience the character’s development as the campaign progresses and give him more personality.
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Update # 1
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow inhabitants of our little forest! A week has passed since the release. It was a difficult and exciting week for us. It was very interesting to receive the first reviews, to look at the first video recordings how people perceive the game.
After the update, [b]it is highly recommended that you start a new campaign[/b].

What's New in version 0.124:
[olist]
[*] Reworked the system of experience and rewards for leveling up. Now the hero has a maximum level of 20. The amount of experience required to level up is increased. In the beginning, this is almost not noticeable, but after about 12 levels it becomes more noticeable. Reduced experience modifier for the number of opponents in heavy battles. On the other hand, each level up now significantly enhances the hero. You no longer get dull +2 hp. Instead, almost every level gives: a random common item, an increasing health bonus and one of three: an increasing power bonus (damage from all cards), a bonus to starting energy and energy gain. Exception is the first 3 levels. Also, leveling up restores 20% of current health, which should somewhat facilitate the exploration of the map at the beginning of the campaign. About the reasons for such changes at the end of the post.
[*] Redesigned the mechanics for determining the danger level for the player. Now it has become more sparing. And a little more fair. Opponents will no longer grow in strength so fast. Rather, it will be more dependent on the player’s actions in the process of moving over the map.
[*] Inventory opens automatically when a new item is obtained. I have often observed situations when players receive good items, but forget to add them to the bag. They go to the next battle and lose because of this. I also got a lot of feedback on this topic. I myself sometimes forgot to add new items to my bag =_=
[*] Changed the temp for battle escalation. Now, the growth of enemy damage in battle occurs every second turn starting from the fifth.
[*] Changed the danger bonus for completing the region and the starting danger bonus in the central region.
[*] Added the ability to view your deck on the region screen. Feature was requested a lot =) In fact, it has long been in the plans, but it always seems that I have more important tasks to do.
[*] Added the ability to view unlocked cards in the main menu. Now you can examine all the cards known to your hero and estimate how many unknowns remain.
[*] Big changes for the tutorial. Removed half of the dialog popups. Half made contextual. You will not see them until they are needed. I tried to make the dialogs less saturated with text, more visually informative. Ok, I realized that people do not like to read. Unfortunately, it makes no sense to create an interactive tutorial right now, as the game can change a lot more than once in next updates. But still, the game has a lot of important mechanics and rules. Somehow they need to be explained.
[*] A tutorial about the level of danger and rarity of cards has been added. If you did not know, our cards have rarity level and this is visually represented =_=
[*] Replaced fonts almost everywhere in the game. The text began to look stylish, but still comfortable to read.
[*] Added a special frame for items that can not be removed from the bag. Now they are especially distinguished from the others and help to avoid accidental additions.
[*] Added tooltip for energy income bar. Well, you never know, players sometimes considered it to be armor.
[*] Reduced the delay in the appearance for the tooltip in the game to 0.1 seconds. It was 0.2 seconds and many thought it was very long.
[*] Updated game interface. On the way update of the interface for the battle scene.
[*] Added a beautiful splash screen at the start, smoothly transitioning to the main menu.
[*] Added a special campaign end dialog. This is still not how the adventure of our hero should end, but at least something. I look forward to implement the story module of the game.
[*] Added a menu button on the campaign screen.
[/olist]

Bugfix:
[olist]
[*] Fixed display of the danger level in the profile of the hero
[*] Fixed a bug for items that gives armor at the beginning of the turn. Before that, they always skipped the first turn.
[*] Added description of exactly how much HP the “Restoration" card will restore
[*] Fixed presentation of items in the dialog box for selecting an item.
[*] Cards no longer request combo selection if no opponents remain in the battle. The exception is cards that with their combo abilities can restore the player’s health or bring some gold
[*] Fixed incorrect tooltip for energy bar in battle scene. It described the conversion of a card into energy by dragging a card into an energy zone. It used to work that way. I thoroughly simplified the mechanics, but I forgot to change the description. Believe me, you are lucky that you have not seen this way of conversion =)
[*] Fixed bug interface responding poorly to button presses. Sometimes this could be noticed when going through a tutorial or closing dialogs. It tormented me for a long time, but I just could not understand what was the matter. Problem was in the plugin for implementing the interface we use.
[*] Fixed bug for card preview not showing on cursor hover.
[*] The image for the “Eexploooosion!” card has been changed. Before that, there was the same picture that “Fireball” had.
[*] Corrected a typo in English localization in the description of “Super Potion”: helath -> health
[*] Fixed a number of grammatical errors in English localization. If you found some grammar errors in the game - please let me know. All translation is made by myself and I’m not a native speaker. Before release we will try to find native speakers to proof read all texts. And may be add more localizations with community help. But it will not happen soon.
[/olist]

About the experience. I would like the players to have a sense of global progress, and the game somehow softens the feeling of many unsuccessful attempts to go through the region. The game should not be played in an hour from scratch. But it should not slide into an endless grind either. Bonuses for leveling up are primarily a help mechanics. And only then a way to convey to the player the feeling that his character has become stronger. Ideally, the player should be able to go level 1 to the central region and defeat the King at level 2 or 3. So far, this is extremely difficult, if possible at all. But in the future it will be fixed. The essence of the game is not in the goal, but in the path that you make. But to understand this, you will need a story module.
In general, it is very difficult to find a balance so that the player was also interested in playing at the first level in the first region with a weak deck as well as at level 20 in the last region with a deck full of heroic cards. But I will continue to work on this, as it is very important. Current changes are just the first step.

What to expect in next weekly updates:
[olist]
[*] Next week I plan to closely engage in the redesign of about half of the existing cards. Many cards were completely useless, although they seemed pretty good during design. I don’t want the game to have useless cards. This greatly affects the progress of the player when in the reward player is offered a choice of 3 useless cards. Several such situations in a row can put an end for the run of the region. And opponents may begin to seem unreasonably strong. It should not be that way.
[*] The merchant must adjust his assortment to the player's progress in the region. The further you go on the map, the more interesting the cards should be. Keep in mind, the merchant sells only those cards that you already unlocked!
[*] Gold. It works very poorly as a resource now. This is partly due to the fact that few cards  uses it and there is rarely any motivation to spend it for the merchant.
[*] Some items are too weak. Some are too boring. Some are never used. This will be fixed.
[*] New foes. Art for the north foes is almost 80% ready. Most likely, next week new inhabitants will appear in our forest. And in the future they will have their own special traits. If you did not know, then each opponent has a fixed set of traits =) Although not all of them are equally interesting. Yet.
[/olist]

notes.title: Finally early access!
notes.notes:
Dear players. We are very glad to welcome you in the debris of our small forest =)

 Half a year of hard work is finally behind us. Even more waits ahead. But we can finally present our new game to the world. We hope you enjoy it!
We understand that the game does not yet produce a wow effect and that it lacks a lot. To date, the game is ready for about 40% of the planned.

Your feedback and suggestions are very important to us. This will help us to direct the development in the right direction and make the game as fun as possible. Seriously =)
We plan to release regular updates and inform you about our plans to improve the game.

So far we would like to talk about what we plan to add during the development process:
[list]
[*] More cards! Now this is only the first iteration. We will try to understand what is “interesting” and what is not in the game. There will be more interesting, less “not”.
[*] More items!
[*] More fun abilities of cards, items and opponents changing the usual gameplay!
[*] More routes for missions run! Way more. Each route is created manually, not procedurally generated. We hope this will give the game more personality and fun exploring time.
[*] 2 new regions with unique designs.
[*] Story! Setting! World! We understand how important the story and setting is to immerse yourself in the world of adventure. The main plot has already been written, but requires proper integration into the game and presentation. It is also necessary for making decisions during the game.
[*] Making decisions. When you defeat the Baron, what will you do? Execute him for serious crimes or spare? How will this affect your adventure? What about the Mad King? Is he really that insane?
[*] Balance! Balance is complicated. A good balance is insanely difficult. We hope to achieve a balance with your help based on your feedback and suggestions! 
[/list]

Stay tuned for new updates and let us know what you think in discussions.
